content:
We have template details. The retro_smarts_template shows transformation: product (left side) is [O]=[S](-[c])-[NH]-[c] (sulfonamide) -> precursors: Cl-[S](=O)(=O)-[c] and [NH2]-[c] (aryl chloride and aniline). So applying to target molecule will give those two precursors.

Now we need to apply this template to the target molecule. The target SMILES? Likely the sulfonamide product: 'Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)O)cc2)cc1' (the earlier product). Let's apply template to that SMILES using apply_template tool.
